svg.text: Daily event-to-price learning pipeline · fully serverless · single account, three environment stacks · us-east-1
Outbound HTTPS only — no inbound path
from any source into the account.
Single account. Environment isolation is IAM only — env-prefixed resources, prefix-scoped policies, explicit denies on prod (ADR-0024).

g.text: No VPC — deliberate, not an omission
Every component is a managed endpoint; nothing needs an ENI.
A NAT gateway alone (~$32/mo) would double total spend.

svg.text: Compute · no model call occurs anywhere in this group (ADR-0004, REQ-1005)
Import-boundary lint (T0.9) fails the build if a model client is imported anywhere in this group.
Scoring is arithmetic only (REQ-801) — a model that scores could grade its own homework.
Container compute — Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime
Container host only — no agents run on it (ADR-0041). Warm model weights · per-second active-CPU billing
Both are numeric libraries called by pipeline code — tier 1, not agents.
No Bedrock call, no SageMaker endpoint (~$75/mo standing per model, avoided).
Each is a single-shot call against a code-assembled prompt. No tools, no loop, no choice about what to read.
Tier 3 — agents — is empty by design (SystemDesign §2.1).
Runtime rates: $0.0895/vCPU-hr, $0.00945/GB-hr — CPU charged on active use only, so I/O wait on Bedrock is free.
Artificial Intelligence · model IDs resolved per role from SSM, never hardcoded (ADR-0027, ADR-0040)
One call a day costs more than eleven. Deliberate (ADR-0040): under forward-only a bad prediction is scored and forgotten,
while a bad wiki page compounds with no replay machinery left to repair it. The money follows the irrecoverable failure.
a crash leaves the previous wiki state valid,
which is what makes a run atomic.
Networking & Content Delivery · Application Integration · Security
invokes · state machine enforces step order 10 → 11 → 12 → 12a/12b → 16 (REQ-1012)
InvokeModel — the only path to a model anywhere in the system
